guide.comoTomarTusFotos: How to take your photos in 3 steps
guide.paraQueElDr: So Dr. Jaime Arcila can evaluate your teeth accurately, follow these simple tips with your phone camera.

items.title: Natural smile, straight on
items.description: A front-facing shot in good natural light, with relaxed lips and a spontaneous smile showing your teeth.
items.tip: Avoid harsh shadows and don't use beauty filters.

items.title: Smile in profile / three-quarter view
items.description: This lets Dr. Jaime Arcila assess how your teeth project, your lip profile and how your smile works with your nose and chin.
items.tip: Turn your head slightly, about 45 degrees, while looking at the camera.

items.title: Close-up of your teeth
items.description: A clear close-up showing the edges of your upper and lower teeth while biting down normally.
items.tip: Focus sharply on your teeth in good daylight.
